newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 3.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 3.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Clear skies and warm weather with maximum winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high. Medium to strong rains along most of the coast, with electric storms in Chiapas and Oaxaca. -- Gulf of Mexico:
Rains expected along the coast of Veracruz and Tabasco. Generally sunny skies in northern region, with winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.

Partly cloudy and rainy along the coasts of Honduras, Nicaragua and Panama. Probability of rains along Mexico's Quintana Roo, Yucatan peninsula, Cuba and Belize. Winds at 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
